relevant_prelims_pyqs.question_text: A legislation which confers on the executive or administrative authority an unguided and uncontrolled discretionary power in the matter of application of law violates which one of the following Articles of the Constitution of India? [2021]
relevant_prelims_pyqs.source_pdf: X-Factor Prelims- Indian Polity for Pre'2027.pdf
relevant_prelims_pyqs.markdown_formatted:
**Q5 (2021)**: A legislation which confers on the executive or administrative authority an unguided and uncontrolled discretionary power in the matter of application of law violates which one of the following Articles of the Constitution of India? [2021]
- (a) Article 14
- (b) Article 28
- (c) Article 32
- (d) Article 44
- **Answer**: `(a)` ([View Source Page 47](pages/prelims/prelims_page_047.pdf))
